glossEn: make arrangements for / arrange thoughts, ideas, temporal events
note: make arrangements for / arrange thoughts, ideas, temporal events。线索：arrange a meeting / arrange for sb to do / arrange matters。

glossEn: put into a proper or systematic order
note: put into a proper or systematic order。线索：arrange the books / arrange in alphabetical order。与 s1 分界：宾语是否已被安排好（宾语是既成事实 vs 待办事项）。

glossEn: adapt for performance in a different way
note: adapt for performance in a different way。线索：a song arranged for piano / arranged for two voices。现有中文无此义项，属新增 —— 只在音乐/表演语境成立。
